Create a summary table

```text

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# APPROACH: reshape the four measures (visual, vegetative, vocal_start,
# combined) into long format, compute each one's difference from
# quest_tend, then summarise count / mean / sd grouped by
# quest_label x proficiency. This avoids repeating the same summarise
# logic four times and makes it trivial to add more measures later.
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
```text
 

```{r descriptive}
summary_long <- newGap %>%
  # keep only the columns we need
  select(file, quest_label, proficiency, quest_tend,
         visual, vegetative, vocal_start, combined) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(visual, vegetative, vocal_start, combined),
    names_to = "measure",
    values_to = "value"
  ) %>%
  mutate(diff_from_tend = value - quest_tend) %>%
  group_by(quest_label, proficiency, measure) %>%
  summarise(
    n    = sum(!is.na(value)),          # token count
    mean = mean(diff_from_tend, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd   = sd(diff_from_tend, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(quest_label, measure, proficiency)

print(summary_long)

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# WIDE VERSION: one row per quest_label x proficiency, with n/mean/sd
# columns for each measure side by side (often easier to read/report).
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------


summary_wide <- summary_long %>%
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols = c(quest_label, proficiency),
    names_from = measure,
    values_from = c(n, mean, sd),
    names_glue = "{measure}_{.value}"
  ) %>%
  # reorder columns so each measure's n/mean/sd stay grouped together
  select(quest_label, proficiency,
         starts_with("visual_"),
         starts_with("vegetative_"),
         starts_with("vocal_start_"),
         starts_with("combined_"))

print(summary_wide)

# Optional: round for a cleaner display table
summary_wide_rounded <- summary_wide %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric) & !c(quest_label), ~ round(.x, 2)))

print(summary_wide_rounded)

# export to CSV
write_csv(summary_wide_rounded, "newGap_summary.csv")

```

Plot distribution

```{r distribution}


# ---- 1. Reshape data: compute the four "gap" measures ----
# Each measure = (event time) - quest_tend
gapData <- newGap %>%
  mutate(
    visual_gap     = visual - quest_tend,
    vegetative_gap = vegetative - quest_tend,
    vocal_gap      = vocal_start - quest_tend,
    verbal_gap     = combined - quest_tend
  ) %>%
  select(
    file, toeic, proficiency, qType,
    visual_gap, vegetative_gap, vocal_gap, verbal_gap
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(visual_gap, vegetative_gap, vocal_gap, verbal_gap),
    names_to  = "measure",
    values_to = "gap"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    measure = recode(measure,
      "visual_gap"     = "visual",
      "vegetative_gap" = "vegatative",   # spelling as requested
      "vocal_gap"      = "vocal",
      "verbal_gap"     = "verbal/viable"
    ),
    measure = factor(measure, levels = c("visual", "vegatative", "vocal", "verbal/viable")),
    proficiency = factor(proficiency, levels = c("Beginner", "Intermediate")),
    qType = factor(qType, levels = c("Polar", "Open"))
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(gap))

# ---- 1b. Define color mapping ----
measure_colors <- c(
  "visual"        = rgb(0, 1, 0, 1),
  "vegatative"    = rgb(1, 0.65, 0, 1),
  "vocal"         = rgb(1, 0, 0, 1),
  "verbal/viable" = rgb(0, 0, 1, 1)
)

# ---- 2. Plot: density distributions, 2x2 panels (proficiency x qType) ----
p <- ggplot(gapData, aes(x = gap, fill = measure, color = measure)) + 
  xlim(-500,3000) + 
  geom_vline(xintercept = 200, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  annotate("text", x = 200, y = 0.0027, label = "200 ms", angle = 90, vjust = -0.5, size=3, color = "red") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 700, linetype = "dashed", color = "blue") +
  annotate("text", x = 700, y = 0.0027, label = "700 ms", angle = 90, vjust = -0.5, size=3, color = "blue") +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.3, linewidth = 0.8, na.rm = TRUE) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = measure_colors) +
  scale_color_manual(values = measure_colors) +
  facet_grid(proficiency ~ qType) +
  labs(
    #title = "Distribution of Timing Gaps Relative to Question End",
    #subtitle = "By Proficiency Level and Question Type",
    x = "Time (ms)",
    y = "Density",
    fill = "4V",
    color = "4V"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold")
  )
print(p)

# ---- 3. Optional: save the figure ----
ggsave("gap_distribution_2x2.png", plot = p, width = 10, height = 7, dpi = 300)


```
Examine frequency of verbal/viable and any signals for different time thresholds

```{r thresholds}

# Step 1: calculate the four latency measures relative to quest_tend
gapCalc <- newGap %>%
  mutate(
    visual      = visual      - quest_tend,
    vegatative  = vegetative  - quest_tend,
    vocal       = vocal_start - quest_tend,
    `verbal/viable` = combined - quest_tend
  ) %>%
  select(file, toeic, proficiency, qType, quest_label,
         visual, vegatative, vocal, `verbal/viable`)

# Step 2: get the minimum of the four measures for each row
gapCalc <- gapCalc %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(min_gap = min(c(visual, vegatative, vocal, `verbal/viable`), na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup()

# Step 3: bin the minimum values and count data points in each bin
gapCounts <- gapCalc %>%
  mutate(
    bin = case_when(
      min_gap <= 200                     ~ "<= 200",
      min_gap > 200 & min_gap <= 700      ~ "200 < x <= 700",
      min_gap > 700                       ~ "> 700",
      TRUE                                ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  count(bin, name = "n")

# Step 4: count of verbal/viable <= 200
verbalViable_le200_count <- gapCalc %>%
  filter(`verbal/viable` <= 200) %>%
  nrow()

# Step 5: when verbal/viable > 200, count of rows where min of the OTHER
# three categories (visual, vegatative, vocal) is <= 200
otherMin_le200_count <- gapCalc %>%
  filter(`verbal/viable` > 200) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(other_min = min(c(visual, vegatative, vocal), na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(other_min <= 200) %>%
  nrow()

# Step 6: combine everything into one summary table
summaryTable <- bind_rows(
  gapCounts %>% rename(category = bin, count = n),
  tibble(category = "verbal/viable <= 200", count = verbalViable_le200_count),
  tibble(category = "verbal/viable > 200 & other min <= 200", count = otherMin_le200_count)
)

# View results
print(gapCalc)
print(summaryTable)

```
